blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Edge Cloud Technology and Solutions (ECTS) welcomed fourth-year students from Southern Christian College, Mindanao, for an educational tour aimed at providing firsthand exposure to cloud computing technology and real-world IT industry practices. ECTS conducted a company introduction and cloud technology demonstration, highlighting its cloud infrastructure, innovative IT solutions, and the importance of cloud computing in today’s rapidly evolving digital landscape. The session provided students with an opportunity to gain practical insights into how cloud technologies support business operations, data management, and digital transformation, bridging the gap between classroom learning and industry applications.
